This is only a preview. Sinag is locked and has to run in a web browser to open.

On an iPhone or iPad: Apple does not let Safari run files saved on the phone, so open your Sinag web link in Safari instead of this file. Then tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, so it opens like an app.

On a laptop: open the file with Chrome, Edge, Safari or Firefox.
